overview_description.description: BloomTech helps learners of all backgrounds launch tech careers. The company aims to provide a direct, low-risk path to higher income by teaching the skills employers want plus supporting applicants in their job search. The simplified training provided by BloomTech equips applicants for careers in data science, software engineering, and other fields.

about_short_description.short_description: BloomTech provides online technical coding courses including data science, full-stack web and backend development, and free coding courses.

product.name: Full Stack Web Development
product.description: An online course designed to teach students the skills needed to become full stack web developers, covering topics like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and Node.js.

product.name: Data Science
product.description: A program that trains students in data science skills, including data analysis, machine learning, and statistical modeling.

product.name: Backend Development
product.description: A course focused on backend development skills, including Node.js, data persistence, and authentication.

product.name: Career Services
product.description: Support services that assist students in job placement, including resume building, interview preparation, and job sourcing.

product.name: Free Trial
product.description: A risk-free trial period allowing prospective students to experience BloomTech's courses and support services without financial commitment.
